ops.old: Chunks of flathead in crunchy panko, shallow fried golden and served in paper with a zesty lime and chilli mayo for dipping. Cut 500g flathead fillets into bite-size chunks and season. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 120g panko. Shallow fry in 1cm oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Mix 150g mayo with the zest and juice of 1 lime and 1 tsp sriracha. Serve the fish in paper cones with the mayo and lime wedges.
